body:
A simpler reproduce scenario: https://ng-run.com/edit/klKBOX1JNrET1nlYADik?open=app%2Fapp.component.ts

I can confirm that this is a bug and the crux of it that if we've got a directive with a host binding writing to an attribute _and_ we put this directive on `<ng-template>` (and probably `<ng-container>`!) it will throw.

In VE such errors would be silently ignored since since host bindings were part of the usage template so VE _knew_ if it makes sense at all to have a binding on `<ng-template>` / `<ng-container>`.

We could "fix" it ivy by ignoring host bindings on  `<ng-template>` / `<ng-container>` but one could also argue that this is invalid directive usage - here `[kendoGridSelectAllCheckbox]` expects to be put on a regular element (since it wants to set attributes) but it is used on `<ng-template>`. I don't know enough abut Kendo impl but the example given puts the mentioned directive on an `<input>` element: https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/grid/selection/#toc-select-all-feature

@ItielBeeri  do you think that usage of `[kendoGridSelectAllCheckbox]` on `<ng-template>` is a valid one?

@pkozlowski-opensource you're right. Moving the directive to the inner input solved the error. Thank you :)
Unless this is still considered a bug for general compatibility reasons, it can be closed.

> Moving the directive to the inner input solved the error.

Good, thnx for coming back to me with this info! 

> Unless this is still considered a bug for general compatibility reasons, it can be closed.

I will keep it open for a bit to see if there are more similar issues coming in so we can decide if we want to fix it.

## I'm submitting a bug/regression report

## Current behavior
When using `kendoGridSelectAllCheckbox` directive on a template in a `kendo-grid-checkbox-column`, an error is thrown: "TypeError: el.setAttribute is not a function", and the whole grid isn't rendered.

Circumstances:
1. This occurs only in _routed_ components. If the same grid is placed directly in the `AppComponent` (or any other component that explicitly belongs to the root component tree), everything works well.
2. This occurs only on Ivy enabled. When disabling Ivy everything works well.

## Expected behavior
No error on Ivy enabled, just as in previous Angular versions.

## Minimal reproduction of the problem with instructions
An extremely simplified reproduction is in [this GitHub repository](https://github.com/ItielBeeri/ng9-kendo-grid-problem).
1. Clone that repository
2. Run `yarn`
3. Run `ng s` and navigate to the `/list` route

issue.body:
This PR provides a more helpful error than the one currently present:
`el.setAttribute is not a function`. It is not valid to have directives with host bindings
on `ng-template` or `ng-container` nodes. VE would silently ignore this, while Ivy
attempts to set the attribute and throws an error because these are comment nodes
and do not have `setAttribute` functionality.

It is better to throw a helpful error than to silently ignore this because
putting a directive with host binding on an `ng-template` or `ng-container` is most often a mistake.
Developers should be made aware that the host binding will have no effect in these cases.

Note that an error is already thrown in Ivy, as mentioned above, so this
is not a breaking change and can be merged to both master and patch.

Resolves #35994
